verdict.rationale: Belvo has no native natural-language interface, but it markets its own MCP servers ("Connect your AI agents to open finance") with install paths for Cursor and VS Code. That lets an AI agent drive Belvo from natural-language prompts. The evidence is thin, though: it doesn't show which operations the MCP tools expose, and the Cursor/VS Code MCP install on the docs page may only serve documentation rather than run API actions. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, documentation of the MCP tool surface and which actions it can execute, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
